mostWorthwhile.text: Making the collagen-rich matrix showed how cells produce supporting material outside themselves, so tissue includes more than just cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: The muscle branch repeated the message-plus-amino-acids pattern from the collagen branch, though it reinforced the comparison.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the supporting material to assemble outside the living cells after they released its precursors.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures named both development routes, and amino acids were presented as protein building blocks. The details of the culture signals weren't explained, though.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the muscle precursors develop, since the chapter ends before they become mature fibres.
